records.name: environmentDescriptor
records.expression:
{
    environmentId,
    label,
    platform: {
      os: platformOs(hostPlatform),
      arch: platformArch(hostArchitecture),
      ...(machine === null ? {} : { machine }),
    },
    serverVersion: packageJson.version,
    orchestrationProtocolVersion: ORCHESTRATION_PROTOCOL_VERSION,
    ...(databaseMigration === undefined ? {} : { databaseMigration }),
    capabilities: {
      repositoryIdentity: true,
      connectionProbe: true,
      attachmentUploads: true,
      questionAttachments: true,
      fileAttachments: { maxUploadBytes: PROVIDER_SEND_TURN_MAX_FILE_BYTES },
      pullRequests: true,
      pullRequestChecks: true,
      sideChats: true,
      inlineMessageContext: true,
      requiredWorktreeBootstrap: true,
      threadSettlement: true,
      threadAutoSettlement: true,
      storageCleanup: true,
      storageCleanupRun: true,
      databaseStorage: true,
      otlpEndpointCheck: true,
      projectWorktreeCleanup: true,
      settledWorktreeCleanup: true,
      worktreesDirectory: true,
      threadAutoSettlementScope: true,
      threadRestartContinuation: true,
      projectSettingsOverrides: true,
      projectProviderInstanceOverrides: true,
      threadSnooze: true,
      threadForceStop: true,
      environmentThemes: true,
      usageLimitSources: true,
      providerWorkspaceSnapshotsOnDemand: true,
      usagePriceOverrides: true,
      usageModelAliases: true,
      threadPinning: true,
      threadPinReorder: true,
      threadActiveReorder: true,
      threadAutoSettleOptOut: true,
      threadProjectFromScratch: true,
      threadTitleRegeneration: true,
      commandOutputStreaming: true,
      threadVisitedTracking: true,
      threadPullRequests: true,
      threadPullRequestWatch: true,
      pullRequestStackActions: true,
      threadPullRequestLinking: true,
      serverResolvedCommandContext: true,
      threadStop: true,
      ...(hostPlatform === "win32" ? {} : { localServerStop: true }),
      environmentIcon: true,
      projectCloneTracking: true,
      projectOrganization: true,
      ignoredFileListing: true,
      triage: true,
      oneTimeSchedules: true,
      freshContext: true,
      scheduledTaskThreadModes: true,
      npmReleaseLookup: true,
      voiceTranscription: isSpeechPlatformSupported(hostPlatform, hostArchitecture, hostLibc),
      ...(serverSelfUpdate === null ? {} : { serverSelfUpdate }),
      ...(serverInstallation === null ? {} : { serverInstallation }),
      ...(serverSelfUpdate === "boot-service" || desktopAppUpdate
        ? { serverSelfUpdateProgress: true }
        : {}),
      ...(desktopAppUpdate ? { desktopAppUpdate: true, desktopAppChannelSwitch: true } : {}),
      serverBrowser: true,
      peerLinks: true,
      mcpModeLimitHeader: true,
      linkFence: true,
    },
  }

records.name: serverConfigSnapshot
records.expression:
{
          environment,
          auth,
          cwd: config.cwd,
          keybindingsConfigPath: config.keybindingsConfigPath,
          keybindings: keybindingsConfig.keybindings,
          issues: keybindingsConfig.issues,
          providers,
          ...discovery,
          observability: {
            logsDirectoryPath: config.logsDir,
            localTracingEnabled: true,
            ...(config.otlpTracesUrl !== undefined
              ? {
                  otlpTracesUrl: config.otlpTracesUrl,
                  otlpTracesSource: config.otlpTracesSource,
                  otlpTracesVariable: config.otlpTracesVariable,
                }
              : {}),
            otlpTracesEnabled: config.otlpTracesUrl !== undefined,
            ...(config.otlpMetricsUrl !== undefined
              ? {
                  otlpMetricsUrl: config.otlpMetricsUrl,
                  otlpMetricsSource: config.otlpMetricsSource,
                  otlpMetricsVariable: config.otlpMetricsVariable,
                }
              : {}),
            otlpMetricsEnabled: config.otlpMetricsUrl !== undefined,
            ...(config.otlpLogsUrl !== undefined
              ? {
                  otlpLogsUrl: config.otlpLogsUrl,
                  otlpLogsSource: config.otlpLogsSource,
                  otlpLogsVariable: config.otlpLogsVariable,
                }
              : {}),
            otlpLogsEnabled: config.otlpLogsUrl !== undefined,
          },
          settings,
          ...(serverSettings.managedPolicy === undefined
            ? {}
            : { managedPolicy: serverSettings.managedPolicy }),
          shellResumeCompletionMarker: true,
          shellThreadFamilies: true,
          shellOlderSettled: true,
          threadResumeCompletionMarker: true,
          threadSnapshotPagination: true,
          threadFind: true,
          threadFindProgressive: true,
          secretProviderSettings: true,
          secretReferences: true,
          secretRequestReferences: true,
          ...Option.match(scratchWorkspaceRoot, {
            onNone: () => ({}),
            onSome: (root) => ({ scratchWorkspaceRoot: root }),
          }),
          newProjectsRoot: managedFolders.namedProjectsRoot,
          ...(lastEventLoopStall === undefined ? {} : { lastEventLoopStall }),
        }

records.name: processEntry
records.expression:
{
          pid: entry.identity.pid,
          startTimeMs: entry.identity.startTimeMs,
          ppid: entry.ppid,
          pgid: Option.none(),
          status: entry.status || "Unknown",
          cpuPercent: entry.cpuPercent,
          rssBytes: entry.residentBytes,
          elapsed: formatElapsed(entry.runTimeMs),
          command: entry.command || entry.name || "unknown",
          depth: Math.max(0, entry.depth - 1),
          childPids: entry.childPids,
        }

records.name: processSnapshot
records.expression:
{
        serverPid: process.pid,
        readAt: snapshot.readAt,
        processCount: processes.length,
        totalRssBytes: processes.reduce((total, entry) => total + entry.rssBytes, 0),
        totalCpuPercent: processes.reduce((total, entry) => total + entry.cpuPercent, 0),
        processes,
        error: Option.map(snapshot.health.native.lastError, (message) => ({ message })),
      }
